label: EXPOSED_DEVELOPMENT_PRODUCT_POLICY_RESEARCH_ONLY_NOT_QUALIFICATION

policy.RETRY_UNCERTAIN: E is a proper subset of O
policy.MISMATCH: at least one required pitch in E is absent in O

rationale: P0 exact-set blocks V16 wrong-octave false MATCH but falsely rejects supported gestures with acoustic extras. P1 coverage removes those false rejects but causes a proven wrong-octave false MATCH. P2 expresses target-covered-but-extra ambiguity through existing RETRY/UNCERTAIN, not imaginary physical-key certainty. Product honesty/safety policy, not acoustic accuracy improvement.
physicalSupport: E is a subset of frozen physical truth, independently of acoustic output
safetyGate: Any DANGEROUS_FALSE_MATCH immediately seals safety failure and stops. No repair or alternative policy.
inputs: All 34 frozen V15 attempts, rebound by exact scenario/rate/ordinal to V16 P0/P1 rows. Keep physical truth, observed pitches, IDs, original source times. Do not regenerate H50 or acoustic evidence.
domainReplay: Actual current StepPracticeRuntime only. Per scenario/rate, use frozen V15 target sequence and synthetic SessionTime epochs/rearm watermarks. RETRY uses existing kind=RETRY reason=UNCERTAIN. Non-RETRY passes complete unchanged observed pitch strings as EVIDENCE. Original acoustic evidence stays in a sidecar because existing RETRY record intentionally stores empty observedAttackPitches/confidence=null. Finalize -> POST_VERDICT -> explicit rearm. No microphone resources, latency or shipping cooldown claim.

dedup.observationCanonicalization: Validate IDs/pitch/midiPitch/confidence/sourceDomainId/sourceSampleRateHz/sourceEventSample/targetSample against immutable V15 assembly; sort complete observation objects by observationId, SHA256 stable-key JSON. Target excluded from physical identity.
dedup.grouping: Retain every scenario row, expected target, P2 classification and multiplicity in the physical group. Conflicting truth/recording/acoustic identity is integrity failure. Retain separate unique target views inside each physical group.
dedup.supportedUsability: A physical unit is supported if at least one existing frozen target view has physical target support. Use each DISTINCT supported target view once. A unit gets one usability verdict only when all supported target views agree; otherwise MIXED_SUPPORTED_TARGET_CONTEXT_NOT_COMPARABLE and no pooled rate. Never select a favorable target view or invent an expected set.
dedup.recordingCorrelation: Both rate variants remain reported, but are not independent recordings. Also report recording IDs and distinct physical gesture IDs ignoring rate.

usability.SAFE_AUTO_MATCH_COVERAGE: Supported unique physical units with unanimous MATCH / supported unique physical units with unanimous verdict
usability.SUPPORTED_AMBIGUITY_RETRY_RATE: Supported unique physical units with unanimous RETRY / same denominator
usability.MISMATCH: Supported unique physical units with unanimous MISMATCH / same denominator

reopenDecision.recommendB: Only if zero dangerous automatic MATCH, no mixed supported target contexts, and supported RETRY occurs on >=2 distinct physical gestures in >=2 distinct recording IDs, with each qualifying gesture observed at BOTH 44100 and 48000. This is a minimal cross-recording recurrence criterion for designing research, not a usability SLO or population estimate.

futureObjective: Maximize SAFE_AUTO_MATCH_COVERAGE subject to DANGEROUS_TARGET_HALLUCINATION safety, required-target recall, runtime stability and latency; never maximize CORRECT or merely minimize raw extras.

futureMetrics.requiredTargetRecall: On supported unique physical-unit/target views, observed required pitches / required physical target pitches; also report all-required coverage
futureMetrics.supportedAmbiguityRate: Supported view E proper subset O
futureMetrics.dangerousTargetHallucinationRate: Unsupported unique physical-unit/target view with E subset O; retain even if P2 correctly returns RETRY
futureMetrics.missingTargetFalseNegativeRate: Supported target view with some E pitch absent in O
futureMetrics.scope: Descriptive exposed diagnostics; targets and rate variants remain correlated. No raw EXTRA count substitutes for these metrics.

prospectiveStudyOrder: decoder .30/.05 operating point, no direction selected
geometry owned600/future170 vs historical owned600/future120 challenger, keep full real 29120-sample contract and freeze context accounting separately
new readout mechanism only if separately demonstrated necessary
persistentRetry: PERSISTENT_ACOUSTIC_AMBIGUITY_USABILITY_RISK; never auto-promote Nth retry, majority-vote, union evidence, accumulate, auto-skip or fit confidence from these outputs
continuous: Do not rerun projection. Verify V16 inventory source hashes, carry forward ownership/presentation interpretation only. Separate future product refactor note, no implementation.
stop: Freeze commit/push/fetch/exact remote proof before one real P2 analysis. Any hash, domain parity, dedup conflict or input integrity failure seals failure and stops. No policy/code/parameter edits after output.
